posts.title: $1,000,000 homepage statistics
posts.description: If you have read about the internet culture of 2005, you might know about the Million Dollar Homepage . Its Wikipedia article states that “by 2017, most links have suffered from link rot”. But 2017 was almost a decade ago, so I wanted to check whether how much worse it got in 2026.
